## Accessibility

Tick each item that applies, or write N/A. The expectations are in [ACCESSIBILITY.md](https://github.com/Gooder24/reboot-when-idle/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md#contributor-expectations).

- [ ] The output stays plain text: no meaning depends on colour, and no state is shown by a symbol alone.
- [ ] New or changed messages say what happened and what to do next, in words.
- [ ] Documentation: headings in order, descriptive link text, text in every table header cell.
- [ ] I tried the changed commands with the keyboard only, and say how below.
- [ ] Anything I could not check is listed here, so a maintainer can check it.
